meta.name: grill-with-docs
meta.description: A relentless interview to sharpen a plan or design, which also creates docs (ADR's and glossary) as we go.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 通过对话打磨方案并自动生成文档
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在讨论中同步产出设计文档和术语表
copy.tagline_en: Sharpen plans through interviews and auto-generate docs
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to produce ADRs and glossaries while refining a design

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会通过持续提问帮你完善计划或设计，并同时生成架构决策记录和术语表。
howto.when: 当你需要梳理或优化一个计划、设计方案时，可以主动发起。

say.text: 我们来做一个 /grilling 会话，帮我完善这个设计方案。
say.note: 启动技能，Claude 会开始提问并记录决策。

say.text: 帮我梳理一下这个项目的架构，并生成 ADR。
say.note: 技能会生成架构决策记录。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude will help you refine a plan or design through relentless questioning, while simultaneously creating Architecture Decision Records (ADRs) and a glossary.
howto.when_en: When you need to sharpen or review a plan or design, you can initiate the session.

say_en.text: Let's run a /grilling session to refine this design.
say_en.note: Starts the skill; Claude will ask questions and record decisions.

say_en.text: Help me review this project's architecture and generate ADRs.
say_en.note: The skill will produce architecture decision records.
